title: A bare SUM over a column of the iterated table itself is still the total of the whole column

source.quote: because SUM computes the sum of all unit prices visible in the current filter context, the result is, for each product, the sum unit prices from the entire table
source.supports: SUM of a column of the iterated table, in a row context only, gives the sum over the entire table

derivation: SUM uses the filter context, not the row context. The filter context is empty, so every row gets 100 + 20 + 10 + 50 = 180, not its own price.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
